"Fog forms when moist air cools near the ground and tiny droplets of water hang in the air. In northern India it is common on winter mornings, when it can slow down trains and flights. Answer the following:

(ii) When is fog common in northern India?  (a) Only in spring  (b) On summer afternoons  (c) During monsoon nights  (d) On winter mornings
